 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**respond**" means to react or behave in response to something. (प्रतिक्रिया करना)
 
• In the context of the passage,** "respond to extreme weather events"** implies how native and non-native species react to conditions like wildfires, droughts, and other weather extremes.
 
• The other options: "**simulate**," "**flirt**," and "**bargain**" do not fit the context as they would not make sense in this sentence about species' reactions.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** "*To better understand how native and non-native species respond__ to extreme weather events, the scientists behind the new study reanalysed information........"*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Simulate (अनुकरण करना)**: means to imitate or reproduce the appearance or character of something.
 
• **Flirt (छेड़खानी करना)**: means to behave as if attracted to someone, but without serious intentions.
 
• **Bargain (सौदा करना)**: means to negotiate the terms and conditions of a transaction.
